page.overview:
What is Sand Sisters?

The Sand Sisters were a group of females who had a convent on the cliffs beside the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica close to the Court of the Sand Sisters. the court had become a popular place for trysts and the convent had become the pied-à-terre for an anonymous arms dealer from Bonadan.

The Sand Sisters were mentioned in the 2025 reference book Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition in a section authored by Jason Fry.
